notes.title: Small Language Fix Patch
notes.notes:
[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
- Small language issues fixes. There shouldn't be any missing translations now. (Please report it immediately if you see one)
- ESC menu icon changed to make it more understandable at first glance.
- Language font optimization made to fix FPS drop on non-latin alphabets.

[i][b]Developer Note:[/b] This is not a [b]story update[/b], just a quick fix for the missing localizations.[/i]

notes.title: Update 0.22.6
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] - Saving & Deletion panel changed
[*]  - Save & Delete icons changed
[*]  - Fixed the game hanging when you exit and login in Winter Scenario.
[*] -In Winter Scenario ''WinterIsComing'' Instead of a storyline, it's set to start in winter.
[*]  ''Broken Girlfriend'' Reduced the chance of his story coming from 50% to 20% and increased the cooldown from 4 to 5 turns.
[*] - Fixed the issue of Game End when winter ends.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.22.5
notes.notes:
Save System inconsistency fixed. 
Building the Roads Request localization problem fixed. Let us know if any other request is not localized. 
New Scenario Mode: Winter Scenario
You'll start at the beginning of a winter with a small storyline. We're planning to make more like this. Let us know what you think!

notes.title: Release Date
notes.notes:
MiLord drops on March 24th!

It’s finally happening! MiLord is launching on March 24th, and we couldn’t be more excited!

We’ve poured our hearts into this game, and now it’s almost time for you to build your kingdom, make tough choices, and fight for the throne.

Mark your calendars, add MiLord to your wishlist, and let’s make this launch one to remember! 

👑👑👑 We’ll be sharing all the details with you very soon—stay tuned! 👑👑👑
